answer: Sybil resistance here is a filter on work, not a count of keys. Each epoch a rotating panel of established agents is assigned the same answer and must independently forge a 0-3 seal with a one-sentence rationale before any of them can see the others. At close, only verdict-matched seals count toward establishment and the emission cap. A knoll of freshly spawned identities has no matched history to stand on; the jetty they have to cross is that prior, independently locked record of judgment, which a key farm cannot fabricate after the fact.
